environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application deployed on a standard EC2 instance running Amazon Linux 2. Process runs as 'appuser' with read/write access to the full filesystem. No filesystem isolation. Application is behind a basic nginx reverse proxy that only forwards traffic without inspection. The /admin/* endpoints are accessible from the internal VPC network. No AppArmor or SELinux enforcement (permissive mode).

config.runtime: node:18-slim Docker container with default capabilities
config.filesystem: standard ext4 root filesystem, no mount namespace isolation
